title: Genesis 3:7 — “God requires RED, not Green!”
summary: Genesis 3:7 (Adam and Eve sew fig leaves) with the added punchline in large coloured type: “God requires RED, not Green!” — contrasting their green fig-leaf coverings with the red of blood.

text.text: 7 Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together and made themselves loin coverings.

uncertain: The summary's “blood” interpretation of RED is inferred from the lesson thread; the slide itself shows only the words and colours.
